cryptography_and_vault.scope: BBS selective disclosure, holder and request signatures, tampering, revocation, expiry, encryption and owner approvals

checks: Registered issuer mints a holder-bound demo credential
Identical mint retries preserve the original record
Mint retries cannot change the holder
Unregistered accounts cannot mint credentials
Unregistered accounts cannot revoke credentials
Public NFT metadata excludes filenames, documents and personal claims
Transfers and marketplace approvals refuse credential resale
Only the designated verification relay records checks
A valid relay result records a publicly inspectable proof hash
A verification nonce cannot be reused
Expired verification requests are refused
Only the admin controls issuer trust; suspension blocks verification
Live revocation blocks subsequent verification
Self-recorded documents cannot verify qualifications
Already expired credentials cannot be minted
NFT owner enumeration returns the holder’s records
Landing page and interactive disclosure preview render
Home fits desktop, 390px and 320px widths
A new encrypted vault opens without a blockchain wallet
A real file becomes an unverified NFT while the original stays local and downloads unchanged
IndexedDB contains an encrypted envelope rather than plaintext files or credentials
Owner consent creates a real proof with requested fields and excludes hidden name, score and original file
Backend independently accepts the proof and confirms a live NEAR verification receipt
Reusing the same verification request is rejected
Consent history preserves the successful receipt after a rejected replay
Eight real cryptographic lab checks pass, including altered fields, holder substitution and excess disclosure
Lock removes private content and an incorrect password cannot unlock it
Encrypted backup restores the documents and holder on a separate browser
Owner-authorized live revocation blocks exported credential proofs
Vault and verification desk fit 390px and 320px mobile viewports
Malformed proof input is refused before verification
API requests never receive the vault password, original file, encoded original or private filename
No browser exceptions in the full tested workflow
A separate verifier imports and accepts an active proof without creating or unlocking a vault
Verifier UI shows requested course and completion fields while omitting hidden name and score
Verified results fit desktop, 390px and 320px viewports
The hosted API rejects an action signed by a different holder
The hosted API rejects a changed claim even when the legitimate holder resigns it
No browser exceptions in independent-verifier checks

boundaries: The issuer and certificate claims are fictional demo data.
Uploaded documents are self-recorded and unverified.
Document bytes are encrypted locally; ownership and blockchain activity remain public.
The verification relay runs BBS math; the smart contract does not execute it.
